question: Find the name and strength attribute value of the strongest Marvel Comics superhero who has blue eyes and brown hair.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_019", T4."XCL_011"
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1."XCL_022" = T2."XCL_005"
INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1."XCL_023" = T3."XCL_005"
INNER JOIN publisher AS T5 ON T1."XCL_026" = T5."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T4 ON T1."XCL_018" = T4."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T6 ON T4."XCL_010" = T6."XCL_003"
WHERE T2."XCL_006" = 'Blue'
  AND T3."XCL_006" = 'Brown'
  AND T5."XCL_015" = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND T6."XCL_004" = 'Strength'
ORDER BY T4."XCL_011" DESC
LIMIT 1;
